fresh_internal_checks.check: The foundation pushforward result allows any smooth real background and any genuine admissible potential, without a closed-pole or top-degree mass assumption.
Modification descent gives a genuine admissible locally integrable pulled-back potential.
Degree-one change of variables off the analytic exceptional loci gives pushforward of the pulled-back potential distribution and smooth background.
Proper pushforward commutes with ddc, so full curvatures push forward exactly.
Borel restriction commutes with the weighted coefficient-measure pushforward; this is not an assertion that arbitrary restrictions are closed.
The exact pulled-back pole set is the inverse image of the downstairs Borel pole set, proving polar compatibility for every modification.
Composition compatibility applies the foundation statement with the semipositive pulled-back background, not an incorrectly assumed Hermitian pullback.
Comparison-Cauchy convergence gives total-variation limits separately in every fixed scalar coordinate, retaining the existing ambient completeness proof.
The countable union B_pi of the pulled-back pole sets is a Borel Lebesgue null set.
Total-variation convergence ensures the limiting trace measure assigns no mass to the complement of this exact union; weak convergence alone would not suffice.
Closed pole sets invoke the previously checked closed complete pluripolar restriction theorem, giving closed positive polar currents.
Their fixed Gauduchon trace masses are bounded by A_pi using the previously proved linear Stokes bound, without BMP.
Positive-current mass compactness on each compact modification gives a weakly convergent subsequence; positivity and closedness pass to its limit.
Wedge with the fixed smooth Hermitian trace form is weakly continuous, identifying every current limit trace with the same total-variation limit.
Positivity dominates coefficient variations by trace and makes every current limit carried by B_pi.
The null-current trace lemma makes any two subsequential current limits equal; subsequential compactness then gives weak convergence of the whole sequence.
Proper pushforward is weakly continuous on smooth test forms and gives g_*R_pi-prime=R_pi for the stated coordinate pairs.
Each coordinate limit is obtained separately; no diagonal subsequence over the possibly uncountable modification set is used.
The dyadic partial sums of nonpositive normalized models decrease and remain omega-psh because their coefficient sums are at most one and omega is positive.
Normalized compactness bounds their L1 norms and the decreasing-limit corollary gives one genuine global pole carrier h.
Every original pole belongs to the pole set of h, so all full current limits are carried by its pulled-back pole sets.

The result asserts weak convergence of full currents and total variation of traces, not coefficientwise strong variation or equality with Pol(h); general model separation, realization and formal problems remain unresolved.
